rows.grounds: compound naming root Kaula in siddhi attainment

items.question: What is identified as the root of Kaula attainment of siddhis?
items.inference: The verse names root Kaula in siddhi attainment.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of eight is unclear.
items.plain_english: Eight, and the root Kaula of siddhi attainment, O fair-faced one.
